mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video (title, description, file_name, original_name, url, cover_url, size, duration, format, category, tags, play_count, like_count, uploader, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{fileName}, #{originalName}, #{url}, #{coverUrl}, #{size}, #{duration}, #{format}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{playCount}, #{likeCount}, #{uploader}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM video WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT FROM video
deleted = 0 AND status = 1
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND category = #{q.category}
ORDER BY play_count ORDER BY like_count ORDER BY size ORDER BY create_time
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video
deleted = 0 AND status = 1
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE video SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE video SET play_count = play_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE video SET like_count = like_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM video WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category
SELECT FROM video WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY play_count DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
